# Shai Peretz

> Shai Peretz is a DevOps Manager at Check Point Software Technologies in Tel Aviv, Israel, with 10+ years in platform engineering and 5+ years leading engineering teams. Shai leads an 11-engineer team building CI/CD infrastructure, cloud platforms and internal tooling for a global R&D organisation, and is driving AI tooling adoption (including MCP servers) in engineering workflows.

## Career

- 2023–present: DevOps Manager, Check Point Software Technologies (AWS, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, Terraform, Terragrunt, Python, Node.js)
- 2021–2023: DevOps Team Lead, Perimeter 81
- 2020–2021: Senior DevOps Engineer, Palo Alto Networks
- 2017–2020: Senior DevOps Engineer, Radware
- 2015–2017: Java Software Engineer, Matomy
- 2012–2015: Software Engineer – Automation, Pitney Bowes
- 2009–2012: Tier 3 Support TL, Odoro Inc.
